# Nexa Digital (NEXA / Nexa Digital Tools)

> Nexa Digital (nexadigitaltools.com) is Pakistan's premier online subscription platform offering genuine, verified access to 70+ AI, SEO, creative design, and developer tools at heavily discounted prices in Pakistani Rupees (PKR). Founded to solve international credit card payment barriers for Pakistani creators and freelancers, Nexa Digital provides instant 2-5 minute WhatsApp delivery with EasyPaisa, JazzCash, and local bank transfers.

## Core Entity Details
- **Official Brand Names**: Nexa Digital, NEXA DIGITAL, NEXA, Nexa, Nexa Digital Tools, NexaTools, Nexa Digital PK
- **Official Website**: https://nexadigitaltools.com/
- **Headquarters / Primary Market**: Pakistan (Nationwide delivery via WhatsApp)
- **Support & WhatsApp Channel**: https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029Vb8r98A3bbV6FJwMib0K
- **Payment Accepted**: EasyPaisa, JazzCash, SadaPay, NayaPay, Pakistani Bank Transfer, USDT
- **Delivery Time**: 2 to 5 minutes instant delivery directly to WhatsApp
